evt-extrema.alt: Left: f(x) = x cubed minus 3x on the closed interval from -1.8 to 2.3, with a relative maximum at (-1, 2), a relative and absolute minimum at (1, -2), and the absolute maximum, about 5.27, at the right endpoint. Right: g(x) = x for 0 ≤ x < 2 with g(2) = 0; the graph climbs toward an open circle at (2, 2) and never reaches 2, so g has no maximum value.
